item.title: GALLERY | Wrexham AFC 5-3 Ipswich Town
item.description: Wrexham AFC added a further three points, moving back into the play-off positions, with a thrilling victory over Ipswich Town. The drama began just six minutes in as Kieffer Moore lashed the Red Dragons into the lead but Ipswich were level in the 20th minute. Moore turned provider for Josh Windass to head Wrexham back in front but the hosts were frustrated to concede once more in first-half stoppage time. item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC Women (p) 2-2 Cardiff City Women (Genero Adran Trophy Final)
item.description: Liz Craven saved two penalties as Wrexham AFC Women beat Cardiff City to win the Genero Adran Trophy for the first time in Bangor. After a 2-2 draw in 90 minutes, Craven saved Cardiff’s first two penalties in the shoot-out, and Faye Knox scored the Red Dragons’ winning spot-kick as they triumphed 4-2. item.title: FIXTURE NEWS | Watford vs Wrexham AFC rearranged
item.description: Our match away to Watford at Vicarage Road will now take place on Tuesday March 17 and kick-off at 7.45pm. Originally scheduled for Saturday March 7, the match has been moved as a result of our progress into the FA Cup Fifth Round. Ticket details for the rearranged fixture will be announced in due course.

item.title: U18 PREVIEW | Aston Villa vs Wrexham AFC
item.description: The Under-18s return to FA Youth Cup action on Tuesday night as they travel to take on reigning champions Aston Villa in the hope of securing a place in the Quarter Finals of the competition. After the First Team’s promotion to the Championship last season, the young Red Dragons entered the FA Youth Cup at the Third Round and secured a 5-1 home victory over Port Vale before beating Southend United 3-1 away at Roots Hall. item.description: Phil Parkinson provided the media with a squad update ahead of tomorrow’s clash against Portsmouth. item.title: CONTRACT NEWS | George Dobson signs new Wrexham deal
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce midfielder George Dobson has signed a new contract with the Club, to the end of the 2027/28 season. Dobson, who had previously played under Phil Parkinson at Sunderland, signed for Wrexham in July 2024, following 144 appearances for Charlton Athletic. item.title: CONTRACT NEWS | Ollie Rathbone signs new Wrexham deal
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce midfielder Ollie Rathbone has signed a new contract with the Club, to the end of the 2027/28 season. A product of Manchester United’s academy, Rathbone joined Wrexham in August 2024, following 128 appearances for Rotherham United, where he secured promotion to the Sky Bet Championship and won the EFL Trophy.
